notes.title: Thief Simulator 2: Community Challenge and Thief Tools
notes.content:
Hey, stealth enthusiasts and master burglars in the making,

Community Challenge: Unlock the Ultimate Loot — A Hefty Launch Discount!

If you accept our mission, the huge Thief Simulator 2 community challenge will reward the cunningest and most devoted of thieves. Your job? Gather your fellow thieves, improve your heist techniques, and make sure everyone is playing Thief Simulator 2 on Steam. The launch discount you'll unlock increases as we gain more followers. Keep in mind that our strength lies in our numbers!

The tiers are as follows:
 13,250 followers - unlock a 5% launch discount
 14,500 followers - unlock a 10% launch discount
 17,000 followers - unlock a 15% launch discount
 20,000 followers - unlock a massive 20% launch discount

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/cc6c3fae060ecb103cf1d4554a1ad86901e45ff0.jpg

We know that thieves prefer freebies, but hey, a generous discount isn’t half bad, right? So, gather your burglar buddies, spread the word, and let’s hit that 20,000 followers mark — because even thieves love a good bargain!

Let’s Talk Tools of the Trade
It's crucial to become familiar with the tools you need as you polish your abilities for the ideal robbery. These aren't just any tools; they are the tools that will make you the greatest thief in Thief Simulator 2. They are your keys to success, your henchmen, and your tools of the trade. Let's examine a few in more detail:

Lockpick
This isn't your everyday lockpick; this tool allows you to tackle medium-difficulty locks and even cut open windows for that silent entry. It's the Swiss army knife for burglars! And there are a few versions of this tool!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/bcd6ca0920271ecb0326aaedd17e708e064a4089.gif

Neon Bot’ Drone
Scoping out your heist location has never been easier. Use the drone to mark tenants, inspect the area, and plan your path to victory. Remember, a well-prepared thief is a successful thief!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/8cee19240d1d07b97da6ab6eb9f067d809a4bece.gif

Hacking Laptop
Some loot is behind high-tech security systems. But worry not, with your hacking laptop, disabling security panels and unlocking electronic doors will be a breeze. Make sure to map out the correct path and secure your prize.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/83d831f40b8cc1e46345e53c45e59f23147fbfbd.gif

Sleeping Gas
Ensure a silent and undisturbed heist with the Sleeping Gas. It's your silent partner in crime, allowing you to swoop in and snatch valuables while everyone else is in a deep slumber. It's not just a tool; it's your ticket to a hassle-free burglary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/9328d792d2296eac35a9c9bcd1330c2aa020d407.gif

We've only begun to scrape the surface of the playground for thieves, so stay tuned. The following time, we'll delve even further into Thief Simulator 2's underworld and uncover even more tips and tricks to help you become a master of your trade. notes.title: Huge update on progress of Thief Simulator 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've been quiet because I took some lessons from the Prologue and implemented them in the full game - hence the release date was moved.

A lot of things have changed and I want to go over them - I won't spoil everything, but here are the most important features.

Graphic improvement
People have (rightfully) complained TS2: Prologue looks worse than TS1, and they were right. That, hopefully, has been improved as seen below. I have changed the sky and added new grass which in my opinion made a big, positive difference.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/b1ca13101cffbef7a09f4ab752de8b428596c6ca.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/28bccddb28009b05adbb58d8f3f73257e3e4119f.jpg


New player car, additional car to buy
Previous car was pretty weak - one spot for heavy items, it was slow, looked terrible. I have changed the main car to this one - it has a big trunk for heavy objects, so you can put as many as you want.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/d774902c80677ff645511ff0b993db6665a6979b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/493d3a4e65b6c53036ac87abab088406d4247a52.jpg

Also, once you have enough money, you can buy a sports car which has no storage, but it's a fast way to travel and escape from the police. It's just fun to drive and drift with.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/819e94ff15fd1d04517399d3827f9df531ec65db.jpg

Radio stations
No more listening to a playlist. There are 4 radio stations, three with unique commercial breaks. If you listen closely, you can hear get some stealing tips.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/67f6f09b9afbaf8c101d05468c1b7af884a4f306.jpg
THIEF.FM,  Chill Radio, RockNation and Electro FM were added. Each with unique music

Game saving & loading
Previously, the game saved once in the neighbourhood and when you left the location. Now, you can pretty much save at almost any point with F5, and you also have multiple save slots.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/4a4e8468d5cf52d0a87d4d848aea140ac5392d75.jpg

Steam Remote Play
You can invite a friend with a controller to help you with a burglary. They will control the drone with the ability to make sounds, which distract tenants, and disable cameras.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/357cc25d0d57e55e1af216d024fcde7c6fab3f4b.jpg

Player home improvements
Many new things have been added to the player home. You can store heavy items in the shed. You can also hang stolen paintings inside.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/b364e68ef87d4605b1f711ac125c5c0649c973e6.jpg
There is a new website, HomeRenovator - you can upgrade your house for some cash, fix broken floor etc. It just makes it nicer to live in.
You can also change wallpapers and the floor to your liking.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/01585b844f0ff03b71c7754da5dd6a3527f17487.jpg

Leveling up and selling items
You no longer have to leave the map to gain XP, and to sell items. Everything now happens on one map - you gain experience as you pick up the item, and you can sell it on a pawn shop which is in the neighbourhood.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/158b869e2ed611f14063b7ec55ebfff9665f539f.jpg

Random daily events
A calendar with events has been added. Each day, there could be some event which will alter tenant's routines, or something else. It could be a burglar awareness day - people are more sensitive, or a chill day where everyone is less alert. It could be a festival, where most people will leave at 9 and come back later, so it's easier to break in. There are many of those so I won't spoil all of them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/7f67f1f2febfc1731af5f6ad1d87dd40fe9cbda9.jpg

Jail
You can now go to jail! When you get caught, you have an option to either reload the save, or go to jail. In hardcore mode, there is no option, you go straight to jail.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/d1a03f85e712f57ac47d92d04b7544658cf1548e.jpg
To get out of jail, you can either break out with lockpicks and find the exit, while being cautious of policemen patrolling the station, or you can bail out for 1/4 of your money.
On hardcore mode you lose all stolen items and they are kept at the police station - you can steal them back, if you have the guts.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/8634948b787a95dc32879bba30b94c0cbe99a432.jpg

Payphone timed missions
I have added payphone timed mission to each neighbourhood (two payphones). There are multiple missions where you have to steal a certain item in a limited amount of time - you get paid and gain XP if you manage. You cannot be seen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/39d150c67169d34c93d6a912dad76a51b0a1cdde.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/3579e2949a2cbbfdb6b10c80f504c5619cd75d6e.jpg


There are many more things which I probably forgot, some of them include:

 New websites, like Darkbank
 Ability to run over people
 Police improvements, policemen now shoot at you when you try to escape
 New drone abilities


I don't want to spoil all of it, so see you on release day, soon. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Thief Simulator 2: Prologue will be available for everyone on May 3rd, 2023!
notes.content:
Exciting news for all fans of the Thief Simulator game! A preview of the upcoming Thief Simulator 2 game called Thief Simulator 2: Prologue will be released on May 3rd, 2023. 

This free preview allows players to get a taste of what's to come and explore the life of a master thief.

In Thief Simulator 2: Prologue, players will have the opportunity to explore six unique locations, including four houses. Each house presents a new challenge and requires different skills to complete the heist. The game also features a construction zone and a junkyard, adding even more variety to the gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272420/Thief_Simulator_2_Prologue

The Thief Simulator 2: Prologue release features several challenging missions that players can complete to hone their skills and become better thieves. We encourage all players to leave feedback on their experience, which will be used to improve the full version of the game.

So get ready to wear your black mask and start stealing, because Thief Simulator 2: Prologue is coming on May 3rd, 2023. With great gameplay and exciting missions to complete, you won't want to miss out on this free Prologue!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/e62e276e2e915961988c84d8761f3522b0c10db7.jpg

notes.title: Introducing Steam Cloud, controller support, Leaderboard & more
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
here's the dev of this magnificent product. I have a few nice things to share with you.

The game is 96% done, the remaining 4% being some parts of controller support, bug fixes, loot balance, voice acting and languages.
There are things that were introduced recently:


 Steam Cloud
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/d61e5f01709b6eb66a10c6de7c8d2d75ef09f927.png

There are 5 profiles for save games - each profile can be used by a different player on the Steam account. All profiles will be synced with Steam Cloud, allowing for playing on different PCs.

 Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/cf9b9c21d32d41beac5acab6a7887b94ff1dd4df.png

Yes, the images are missing but not for long. Currently there are 15 achievements you can unlock.

 Full Xbox controller support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/db28d034f4a8d5816c2b525cb9859cab0d986d66.png

Like the title. Pretty nice, yeah?

 Thief's leaderboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/84fc3ad13e0baaf79d53a6455ce99ae0e2b387c9.png

The more you steal, the more experience you gain, the higher up you'll be. I wonder who will be the ultimate thief and get a #1 spot.

Now that's about it. I'm returning to polishing this excellent game about stealing stuff. I just hope I won't steal anything while working.
Stay tuned for more devlogs, as they are coming more often now.

Peace ːluvː

notes.title: You are no longer alone (if you want!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/d46b211b3a5b426167348ebf08c6ac120621a84b.jpg
Hello everyone,
one of the newest features I added is the ability to call an associate and invite them to your stealing fun.

Once they arrive, you can ask them to do one of the following things. These actions use up the action points, and those are limited per session (you can upgrade your associate to have more points).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/a22b8a931cb496c6e321c8ee47be0951e178eb8c.jpg

 Pick locks - unlocks any lock you can unlock instantly (no minigame). 
 Carry heavy items to car - your associate picks up any heavy item and carries it to your car.
 Mark tenants - marks all tenants on the current possession, and learns their habits.
 Call off pursuit - clears one star of police pursuit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/4f9d3d4fd9e22a07d5d02e60ede97cd327fd7441.gif
Your associate carrying a painting to the car

Stealing with your associate is not required to finish the game, but it's something you can use after a certain point in the story.

Stay tuned for more ːluvː

notes.title: Heist Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, time for an update about the main new feature of Thief Simulator 2 - heists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/ea9e44c7fc361ab0c9299a07a573f9d706f063bc.png

Heists are basically high profile robberies - instead of stealing from your neighbour's garden, you actually break into a heavily guarded location, but as expected, the reward is also much bigger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/399a61c607829d4a4491841831f1bc06be19ffa8.png

The first heist will be set in a warehouse, containing all sorts of equipment - electronics, tools, even a new drone for you to use.

To prepare for a heist, you must aquire needed skills and tools, and also steal documents regarding the location. Not all documents are required to start the robbery, but for example, it would be better to find a document containing guard's routines, than not. Trust me.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/bb00e5a85d73218cea73c5a357a8210377872f61.png
There will be several drones to steal - each drone has unique upgrades.

notes.title: Game is not dead
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
just wanted to say the radio silence is over, and I will be back to posting regular updates on the game.
The reason it was so quiet is because I was busy working on the map and placement of NPCs, which is a slow and tiresome process, so there was really nothing to show.
However that's done now, and I can finally shed some light on what's going on with the game. ːsteamhappyː

Story
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/1ee4bd2e0f51246702f05e70e33c6dd3681ebfec.jpg
Beginning of the game - your house is raided by mob assasins

So, what will the story be? 
I can't say everything about it, but a short version would be this: 

In your past, you stole money from a mob, then moved to the middle of nowhere and expected a happy life. They found you, however. And they want you to pay the price, which is the ultimate doom.
You have to get out of there and figure out a way to deal with the mob. What can you do to stop them? Well, the first thing you think of, is to contact the friend who warned you of the night raid. Maybe he can help you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/5b3b1ad407612521df60eefa0f83b0aef7a1f62c.png

Minor stuff


 Special skill points
These points are earned by stealing special items, which grant you 1 point per item. These points unlock extraordinary skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/cf993d837814423e21b52e4f4059495182c1b5cd.png
Special skills make your thief life much easier, so it's worth spending extra time finding the special items

 Non-house locations to rob
There will not only be houses in the neighbourhoods, but also locations such as a scrapyard, or the courier's headquarters with a lot of boxes to steal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/5eafafebd1852ff122faf2f907cc8fa0c70bde59.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/80cd0bb037eac135f5b3af73b71e46dcb024fb84.png

 HellNeighbour missions
Missions will have some variety. There will be not only 'Steal / Destroy' type missions, but also 'Plant the evidence', 'Assault', 'Photograph'. Photograph is pretty much some detective work - you gotta snap a close photo of either a room, a house, or even a person. Assault is what it pretty much says - slam someone's head in with a baton. Sounds fun and engaging.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/76f2a2a4b20a62e2f9768848eea621d0619977d0.png
Plant the evidence

 Phone usage
You will be able to use your phone to take photos, store parcel locker codes found in electronics / houses, and to quick buy a lockpick, if you ever run out of them during burglary.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/ef543744b1f41e102788bfc63029317703cf89dc.png


For now that's it. As for when the game releases, I don't know. There is still a lot to do, I'm in the process of adding missions and I don't want them to be boring or repetitive. Will keep everyone posted about the progress ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Thief Simulator 2 - Work Progress Update
notes.content:
Hi,
this is TS2 dev! We haven't written to you in a long time... actually, we never have - but don't worry, we are alive and working hard on the sequel.

It's not an easy job - the bar has been set high, but we're up to it! 

So what's up? You're probably interested in how the game looks now or what's new in TS2. Let me show you a few things:

1. Drone
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/66177751f19cab8f94b94ceae29dbe62c57623b3.jpg

So basically, this beauty can be used to spy on tenants, without the risk of getting caught. It allows you to learn their habits, and also to look for any loot outside of the house.
When you finally gather some money, you can install several upgrades to your drone, some of which can be extremely useful.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/06eb992b0cb5f3392d02a14e8d453a0a9e336cf1.jpg

2. Dogs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/08347309e9979b0e00ae25deb7cd00dcd962b6bb.jpg

These cute creatures might not be so cute once you see them charging at you. Well, they're an extra layer of protection for the tenants - their hearing and sense of smell is extraordinary, so be very careful around them. You can use some meat to lure them away, but not for very long.

3. ATMs
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/27f40ea7e5369f8c456c251c1122df6c44276f1e.jpg

Now, you can hack ATMs and get some quick cash. Just be careful though, the area is under surveillance. Better disable the cameras first.

4. Pickpocket
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/fb5a45ecfba69b3d67edaa5233117759b24911c5.jpg

Nothing better than to wake up, go out and rummage around in people's pockets. You may find some valuable stuff in there. 

So, what do you think?

There's much more coming quite soon, as the demo is nearly ready. There will be playtests soon for anyone interested. Are you ready to become a master thief again?
